toolchain.max_source_checkout: Modular modular at /tmp/modular-src, sparse max/mojo + Mojo/stdlib

workload.warmup: CPU lanes: two discarded turns; Metal lane: five discarded turns; each process resets state before timing
workload.timed_region: resident EKF turn loop; setup, allocation, compilation and final checksum readback excluded
workload.synchronization: CPU lanes complete each turn; Metal enqueues one resident kernel per turn and synchronizes after every timed turn; checked Metal reads one compact Int32 fault status at each publication boundary

Mojo native Metal resident kernel.numerical_note: Metal uses the target-native llvm.air.atan2.f32 intrinsic because the Mojo host libm atan2 entry point is CPU-only on this toolchain; checksum is reported rather than claimed bit-for-bit equality because device and CPU operation order can differ.

notes: Checked lanes validate finite state/covariance, positive covariance diagonals, and covariance symmetry; invalid candidates retain the previously published state and increment a bounded fault count.
The SIMD lane performs the EKF arithmetic on four filters per SIMD value and uses an all-valid fast store path; the per-lane fallback preserves checked publication semantics when a lane is invalid.

The Metal lane keeps all state and covariance in device buffers and performs one compact Int32 fault-status readback after each checked timed turn; it does not map the per-filter state or covariance during timing.
The optional Metal deferred-synchronization mode is diagnostic only and is excluded from the reported medians because it changes the publication and fault-observation boundary.
The /tmp/modular-src checkout is a build-time source dependency for MAX APIs absent from the installed Mojo package; it is not part of the Mech runtime or benchmark workload.
